body:
Claim: the model's own plan rewrite (B-2026-11-02-2 remainder)

Scope: backend/src/core/agent/loop.py (the todo_write result handler +
the gate-replan diff), backend/src/core/agent/tool_schemas.py (schema
wording), backend/src/tools/todo_write.py (description only if needed),
tests/core/test_planner_lane.py + a new tests/core/test_todo_model_rewrite.py,
scripts/live_test_todo_rewrite.py (new standing harness).

Today any mid-turn todo_write call silently full-replaces the panel
(todo_cleared + one todo_created per item): evidence-backed and retired
rows vanish, no revision diff lands on the record, and the acceptance
contract does not follow the rewrite. The change:

1. The loop diffs a todo_write call against the live panel rows (planner
   plan-{i} rows, or the model's own previous list, or syn- fallback rows):
   dropped OPEN rows retire explicitly (status=retired + reason), genuinely
   new work appends (fresh ids, never renumbering), matched open rows update
   in place, closed rows never churn, and todo_revised {added, retired, kept}
   lands once per actual rewrite — the same machinery S023 gave the gate
   replan, triggered by the model reshaping its own checklist.
2. Revised steps carry outcomes: model-supplied expected_outcome joins the
   acceptance contract (trace.success_criteria / task_state) when absent;
   the gate replan prompt asks for a per-step done-when outcome and the
   parser carries it into the added rows' contracts (backward-compatible:
   bare steps keep the empty outcome).

Hypothesis of safety: the diff only changes the todo_write emission path
and the replan payload parse; plan ids stay stable (S023's fixed-denominator
discipline); the bridge already treats retired as a close state
(chat.py finalize sweep). Fail-open shapes unchanged: an unparsable write
still normalizes through todo_write's own validation.

Verification bar: new unit pins (pure diff + loop-level rewrite behavior),
full backend suite, ruff on touched paths, frontend untouched (same event
shapes the panel already renders), new live harness on the 8765
fake-provider pattern + standing harnesses re-run.
